name: 王之政
objective:
依據提供服務準則，工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康，安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. Engineers must perform under a standard of professional behavior that require adherence to the highest principles of ethical conduct. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.
schedule:
週次	單元主題（中文）	Unit Topic (English)
第 1 週	課程介紹與工程倫理的重要性	Course Introduction & Importance of Engineering Ethics
第 2 週	工程師的社會責任與公共利益	Social Responsibility and Public Welfare of Engineers
第 3 週	工程倫理概述與倫理理論基礎	Overview of Engineering Ethics and Ethical Theories
第 4 週	工程專業精神與誠信原則	Professionalism and Integrity in Engineering
第 5 週	工程實務中的倫理衝突	Ethical Conflicts in Engineering Practice
第 6 週	工程倫理抉擇與決策模式	Ethical Decision-Making Models for Engineers
第 7 週	工程倫理守則概論	Codes of Engineering Ethics
第 8 週	工程倫理守則之解說與應用	Interpretation and Application of Engineering Codes
第 9 週	期中考試	Midterm Exam
第 10 週	工程安全、風險與責任	Safety, Risk and Responsibility in Engineering
第 11 週	工程失誤、災害與倫理反思	Engineering Failures, Disasters and Ethical Reflections
第 12 週	工程與法律責任之關係	Engineering Ethics and Legal Responsibility
第 13 週	專業判斷、利益衝突與吹哨者	Professional Judgment, Conflicts of Interest and Whistleblowing
第 14 週	永續發展與工程倫理	Sustainability and Engineering Ethics
第 15 週	工程倫理個案分析 I	Case Studies in Engineering Ethics I
第 16 週	工程倫理個案分析 II	Case Studies in Engineering Ethics II
第 17 週	工程倫理在現代科技中的挑戰	Ethical Challenges in Modern Engineering and Technology
第 18 週	期末考試	Final Exam
